Since they are symmetric, we need to find equilibrium (or best response) assuming both aim for same objective.

We need to consider possible pairs (A_choice, B_choice). For each pair, C and D will pick cheapest remaining tasks. Compute total distinct tasks and total cost. Then each agent wants to maximize distinct tasks, then minimize total cost. Since they share objective, they will aim for outcomes that achieve max distinct tasks (i.e., 4).
